title: 2021 Panini Playoff #137 Aaron Rodgers Packers

descriptionText:
This 2021 Panini Playoff trading card features Green Bay Packers' star quarterback, Aaron Rodgers. With its parallel and base set features, this sports trading card is a must-have for any NFL fan and collector. The card number is 137 and it belongs to the 2021 season.

The card is from the National Football League (NFL) league and manufactured by Panini. It is not autographed and falls under the category of Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. Add this card to your collection today and showcase your love for the game!
